## What and why

## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `dist/` rebuilt and committed if `src/` changed
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; redaction changes have stop and keep fixtures
- [ ] No real or scanner-flagged secrets, customer data or internal names in code, fixtures or docs
- [ ] Numbers added to docs are labelled measured or modelled, with their scope
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits, at most six words
